about: The apartment's free bodies, which sim/layout.py leaves out of apartment_layout.json (it dumps only the geoms on the world body, and these hang on freejoint bodies): from /work/pollen/microduck_rl/src/mjlab_microduck/robot/microduck/apartment.xml, lines 348-381. Positions are where the simulator puts each at reset; a body the duck pushes moves. Same geom shape as the layout (type, pos with z at the geom's centre, size, yaw, collides), so the Observatory's truth takes both files together. obj_3 is 0.35 m behind the dock start pose: it is the 'phantom obstacle' by the dock of every run (docs/wip/PHANTOM.md).
